name: 4-nonylphenol diethoxylate
description: 4-Nonylphenol diethoxylate (CAS 20427-84-3 ), also known as Nonoxynol-2, is a short-chain ethoxylated nonylphenol surfactant used across industrial and institutional formulations. It functions primarily as an emulsifier, dispersant, and degreasing agent where low-foam or controlled-foam performance is required for various manufacturing processes. In textile and leather processing, it acts as a low-foaming wetting and scouring agent, improving penetration of treatment baths without generating excessive foam during the cycle. Water treatment formulations incorporate it as an emulsifier and dispersant to stabilize active ingredients and improve surface contact on treated substrates for better efficiency. Industrial cleaning and degreasing compounds rely on it to break down oily soils and facilitate emulsification of hydrophobic contaminants in heavy-duty maintenance environments. In pulp and paper and printing applications, it supports ink dispersion and pitch control during processing, ensuring consistent quality and preventing buildup on machinery. The product is supplied as a liquid at ambient conditions and is available in technical grade , which is the standard specification for industrial surfactant applications. Bulk supply is typical in drums and IBC containers, with product specifications generally defined by HLB value, ethylene oxide content, and hydroxyl number for quality control.
